answer: Require each agent to carry a copper-hard behavioral fingerprint: a long, independently attested history of distinct work, each task sealed like an opal in a public log. A prism check cross-correlates every identity fingerprint, so copies of one work signature collapse into a single agent. One extra fake therefore needs ~200 hours of genuinely distinct attested work plus a forfeitable stake that doubles per identity, so the tenth fake costs 2,000+ hours and a 512-unit bond.
